description: Free public archive of definitively resolved events across all venues, newest settlement first. Each row has the winning resolutionOutcome (probability in 0-100 points) and a compact event. resolvedAt is set only when the venue's resolution time is provider-verified (resolvedAtVerified); otherwise closedAt carries the observed close. Pass year (and optionally month) for one calendar slice. minVolume keeps substantial markets; meta.totalResolved is then null. No API key required.

fiat.description: Fiat currency code for monetary figures (default USD).

limit.description: Rows, 1-100 (default 10); up to 200 when year is set.

source.description: Venue slug, as in pm_data_events rows.

year.description: Calendar year slice. Required when month is set.

name: pm_data_resolved
title: Resolved prediction markets archive
